name: Brave Search API
note: Search API on Brave's own index
summary: Brave Search API returns results from Brave's own web index, which Brave crawls and ranks itself. Besides web, news, image and video results it offers an LLM Context endpoint that returns extracted page content within a token budget, and an Answers endpoint with cited summaries.
facts: Search $5 per 1,000 requests; Answers $4 per 1,000 plus $5 per 1M tokens
OpenClaw (first in web_search auto-detection), Hermes Agent
goodFor: A web index that is not resold from another engine
Feeding extracted page text to a model within a token budget
watchOut: A credit card is required, even for the monthly free credits
Search and Answers are billed separately
